description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView implementation that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log entries and displaying them in a UI component.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements the LogNode interface to display formatted log messages within an Android activity.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, handling thread safety by ensuring UI updates happen on the main thread, and delegates to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the subsequent LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
